newsitem.title: UK: Trans Zambesi Industries to list on Zimbabwe SE.
newsitem.headline: Trans Zambesi Industries to list on Zimbabwe SE.

text.p: Southern African conglomerate Trans Zambesi Industries Ltd is to apply for a share listing on the Zimbabwe stock exchange, arranger ING Barings said Tuesday. The listing will be in the form of Zimbabwe depositary receipts (ZDRs), each of which will be equivalent to one ordinary share in TZI. ING Barings will buy a minimum two million TZI ordinary shares at $3.25 apiece to help create the ZDRs.
The offer to buy, which closes on January 30, will be dependent upon the ability to place the ZDRs at or above Z$35 ($3.25) each, ING said.

TZI's managing director Hillary Duckworth said in a statement: "TZI intends to purchase TZI shares on the Luxembourg market and localise them on the Zimbabwe stock exchange to allow investors in Zimbabwe to participate in TZI's future growth".
TZI was worth around $150 million at the tender offer price, Duckworth said. No shares owned by TZI management will be bought under the offer.
